title: Book live captioning services at a service centre
summary: Book an appointment to use free remote live captioning services at a Service NSW centre.
intro:
Remote live captioning in English is available at all service centres, free of charge.

With remote live captioning, you speak to a service centre staff member and a transcriber types the staff member’s reply for you to read in English. This way you can follow along as the words are spoken.

If you'd like to use the service you can book an appointment online and avoid having to wait for a transcriber.

Note: Video remote interpreting is also available if you communicate in Auslan or another sign language.

how_to_steps.text: Schedule your appointment – it's recommended to book before 11am or after 2pm.
Attend your appointment at the service centre.

more_info.text: Live captioning can also help those who have Autism Spectrum Disorder and/or learning difficulties.

internal_links.text: Change or cancel a service centre booking
